s = s[:i] + '''def _check_witness(F, H, bflat, aflat, pflat, guard):
    """Validate predecessor labels as an attaining optimal lineage family."""
    P, N, T, S = F.P, F.n, F.T, F.S
    nst = F.nstates
    anch = F.anch.T.reshape(-1).tolist()
    rooted = [False] * nst
    cells = []
    us = []
    ks = []
    for s in range(nst):
        if bflat[s] is None:
            continue
        if anch[s]:
            if bflat[s] != 0 or aflat[s] != 0 or pflat[s] is not None:
                return False
            rooted[s] = True
            continue
        pr = pflat[s]
        if not isinstance(pr, list) or len(pr) != 2:
            return False
        u, k = pr
        if not _is_int(u) or not _is_int(k):
            return False
        if u < 0 or u >= nst or bflat[u] is None:
            return False
        cells.append(s)
        us.append(u)
        ks.append(k)
    if not cells:
        return True
    nc = len(cells)
    cells_a = np.asarray(cells, dtype=np.int64)
    us_a = np.asarray(us, dtype=np.int64)
    ks_a = np.asarray(ks, dtype=np.int64)
    p_arr = cells_a // N
    i_arr = cells_a - p_arr * N
    pu = us_a // N
    iu = us_a - pu * N
    wb = [0] * nc
    wa = [0] * nc
    ok = [False] * nc
    for x in range(nc):
        if ks[x] == -1:
            if iu[x] == i_arr[x] and pu[x] == (p_arr[x] - 1) % P:
                ok[x] = True
                wb[x] = int(F.w_wb[us[x]])
                wa[x] = 1
        elif 0 <= ks[x] < 2 * F.nl:
            kc = ks[x]
            sn = int(F.dc_src[kc]); dn = int(F.dc_dst[kc])
            gs = int(F.dc_gs[kc]); gd = int(F.dc_gd[kc])
            d = int(F.dc_d[kc]); q = int(F.dc_q[kc])
            r = d // T
            m = d % T
            Delta = r + (1 if m else 0) + q
            if iu[x] == sn and i_arr[x] == dn and (pu[x] + Delta) % P == p_arr[x]:
                ph = pu[x]
                rho = int(F.rho_arr[ph])
                if rho >= guard and rho + d + guard <= S:
                    L = r + (1 if m else 0)
                    lid = kc >> 1
                    if int(F.blpre[lid, ph + L] - F.blpre[lid, ph]) == 0:
                        ok[x] = True
                        wb[x] = int(H[gs, gd]) + F.aging(dn, ph, d, q)
                        wa[x] = Delta
        if ok[x]:
            if bflat[us[x]] + wb[x] != bflat[cells[x]]:
                return False
            if aflat[us[x]] + wa[x] != aflat[cells[x]]:
                return False
    if not all(ok):
        return False
    order = sorted(range(nc), key=lambda x: aflat[cells[x]])
    for x in order:
        if not rooted[us[x]]:
            return False
        rooted[cells[x]] = True
    return True
'''
